findings.evidence: Grep of `code/TauCeti` for `conjugateAbelianizationEquiv` hits only the def (GaloisMaps.lean:188), `_of` (:195), `_one` (:203) and the trans law (:218); no `symm` lemma. The def carries no `@[expose]`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem conjugateAbelianizationEquiv_symm_of (y : (L.conjugate g).Gal) : (L.conjugateAbelianizationEquiv g).symm (Additive.ofMul (Abelianization.of y)) = Additive.ofMul (Abelianization.of ((L.conjugateGalEquiv g).symm y))`, provable by `(L.conjugateAbelianizationEquiv g).injective` + `AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply`, `conjugateAbelianizationEquiv_of`, `MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply`, mirroring `conjugateGalEquiv_symm_mk`.
findings.issue: `conjugateAbelianizationEquiv` (unexposed def, line 188) has only the forward computation lemma `conjugateAbelianizationEquiv_of`; there is no `conjugateAbelianizationEquiv_symm_of`, so the inverse direction has no characteristic lemma, whereas all sibling equivs in this PR now supply one (`conjugateGalEquiv_symm_mk` Conjugation.lean:303, `conjugateCoefficientEquiv_symm_apply_coe` :336, `conjugateGroundLevelEquiv_symm_apply_coe` :354, `conjugateNormQuotientEquiv_symm_normQuotientMk` :471).

summary: Prior findings are resolved: the roadmap's conjugation map on abelianized Galois groups is now a named declaration with of/one/composition laws, and the four layer equivalences carry symm computation lemmas. The new `conjugateAbelianizationEquiv` is itself an unexposed equiv with only the forward `_of` lemma, so its inverse cannot be computed without unfolding or a `symm_apply_eq` detour, unlike every other equiv in this PR.
